matched_playbook.title: Multi-Family & BTR Doorstep Valet Waste & Grounds Playbook
matched_playbook.economic_driver: Landlord NOI Arbitrage (Spread between $30/mo resident fee and $14/mo vendor cost yields +$16/mo pure net profit per door, expanding asset valuation by +$300k+ @ 6% cap rate).
matched_playbook.decision_maker_target: Regional Facilities Director / Community Manager / Asset Manager

pillar_1_economic_arbitrage.rationale: Landlord NOI Arbitrage: 122 doors generate pure net asset profit.

pillar_2_decision_velocity.rationale: Onsite management authority with direct budgetary signoff.

pillar_3_regulatory_compliance.rationale: Tied directly to resident amenity lease covenants and municipal solid waste rules.

pillar_4_operational_density.rationale: Epicenter of existing operational cluster (Plano); 0-mile dispatch radius.

pillar_5_contract_ltv_margin.rationale: Multi-year institutional agreement (36 months); high LTV retention.

assessment.recommended_action: Autonomous Proposal Generation & Outbox Letter Staging (Official Letterhead HWB-COM-001)

safeguards.doorstep_collection_protocol: Service includes five (5) nights per week (Sunday through Thursday) collection of tied, bagged household waste placed in property-approved 13-gallon doorstep receptacles between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM. Collection begins promptly at 8:00 PM.
safeguards.compactor_corral_maintenance: Nightly sweep, litter policing, and deodorizing spray application across the central commercial compactor enclosure and dumpster pad following collection completion.
safeguards.hot_water_pressure_washing: Quarterly high-pressure hot-water sanitization (3,500 PSI @ 200°F) of concrete compactor pads to eliminate grease, organic residue, bacteria, and leachate odors.
safeguards.pet_waste_station_service: Weekly bag restocking, canister sanitization, and waste disposal across all designated community pet waste stations.
safeguards.bulk_junk_hauling_schedule: Move-out bulk items (mattresses, couches, furniture) left in corrals or breezeways shall be hauled away on-demand at $125.00–$225.00 per item upon property manager dispatch.
safeguards.zero_leak_guarantee: Technicians utilize leak-proof vinyl transport containers to prevent liquid leachate stains on breezeways, concrete sidewalks, and interior residential corridors.
